title: Microsoft and OpenAI’s famed AGI agreement is dead
raw_excerpt: OpenAI and Microsoft's partnership-turned-situationship just got even less committed. And a clause about artificial general intelligence, which has for years dictated the future of their deal, has officially been dropped. On Monday morning, Microsoft announced a handful of big changes to its long-standing OpenAI deal. Microsoft will remain OpenAI's "primary cloud partner, and OpenAI products will ship first on Azure, unless Microsoft cannot and chooses not to support the necessary capabilities." But OpenAI can "now serve all its products to customers across any cloud provider." That lets OpenAI pursue its goals of courting enterprise custom … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 微软与OpenAI宣布修订合作协议，正式取消关于通用人工智能（AGI）的条款。此前该条款规定，当OpenAI实现AGI时，微软将失去对其技术的访问权。新协议允许OpenAI向任何云提供商提供服务，不再独占Azure。微软仍为OpenAI的主要云合作伙伴，但OpenAI获得了更大的商业自主权。此举标志着双方关系进入新阶段，为OpenAI即将进行的IPO扫清关键障碍。

title: Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
raw_excerpt: Sam Altman and Elon Musk are set to face off in a high-stakes trial that could alter the future of tech’s leading AI startup, OpenAI. The trial begins with jury selection on April 27th, as Musk pushes forward his 2024 lawsuit that accuses OpenAI of abandoning its founding mission of developing AI to benefit humanity and shifting focus to boosting profits instead. Musk was a cofounder of OpenAI and claims that Altman and cofounder Greg Brockman tricked him into giving the company money, only to turn their backs on their original goal. However, OpenAI says that “This lawsuit has always been a baseless and jealous bid to derail a competitor” in a bid to boost Musk’s own SpaceX / xAI / X companies that have launched Grok as a competitor to ChatGPT. In his lawsuit, Musk is asking for the removal of Altman and Brockman , and for OpenAI to stop operating as a public benefit corporation. Musk has also demanded that OpenAI’s nonprofit receive up to $150 billion in damages he’s asking for if he wins the case. summary: 埃隆·马斯克与山姆·奥特曼的诉讼案于4月27日开庭，马斯克指控OpenAI背离非营利使命，转向逐利。此案可能决定OpenAI能否以营利实体存在，并影响其IPO进程。陪审团将裁决OpenAI是否必须恢复非营利性质，甚至可能罢免现任管理层。该案被视为AI行业治理的标志性事件，其结果将重塑AI公司的商业模式与监管框架。

title: The Download: DeepSeek’s latest AI breakthrough, and the race to build world models
raw_excerpt: This is today’s edition of The Download , our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Three reasons why DeepSeek’s new model matters On Friday, Chinese AI firm DeepSeek released a preview of V4, its long-awaited new flagship model. Notably, the model can process much longer prompts than its last generation, thanks to a new design that handles large amounts of text more efficiently. While the model remains open source, its performance matches leading closed-source rivals from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. It is also DeepSeek’s first release optimized Huawei’s Ascend chips—a key test of China’s dependence on Nvidia. Here are three ways V4 could shake up AI . —Caiwei Chen The rise of world models AI systems have already gained impressive mastery over the digital world, but the physical world remains humanity’s domain. As it turns out, building an AI that composes novels or code apps is far easier than developing one to fold laundry or navigate city streets. To bridge this gap, many researchers believe you need something called a world model. Proponents like Stanford professor Fei-Fei Li and AMI Labs founder Yann LeCun argue these models can overcome the well-known limitations of LLMs—and realize AI’s promise for robotics. Find out why they’ve brought world models to the forefront of the field . —Grace Huckins World models are on our list of the 10 Things That Matter in AI Right Now , our essential guide to what’s really wort…
summary: 中国AI公司DeepSeek发布V4模型预览版，采用全新架构以高效处理超长上下文，性能媲美Anthropic、OpenAI和谷歌的闭源模型。V4是DeepSeek首个支持超长提示的开源模型，在多项基准测试中表现突出。此举进一步缩小了开源与闭源模型之间的差距，对全球AI开源生态产生重要影响。

title: Google employees ask Sundar Pichai to say no to classified military AI use
raw_excerpt: Google CEO Sundar Pichai arrives for the inauguration of President Donald Trump. | Getty Images Over 600 Google employees signed a letter to CEO Sundar Pichai demanding that Google block the Pentagon from using its AI models for classified purposes, reports the The Washington Post . Its organizers claim many of the signers work in Google's DeepMind AI lab, and include more than 20 principals, directors, and vice presidents. According to the Post , the letter says that "The only way to guarantee that Google does not become associated with such harms is to reject any classified workloads. summary: 超过600名谷歌员工（包括DeepMind员工）联名致信CEO皮查伊，要求公司拒绝五角大楼的机密AI项目。信中指出，参与机密军事工作将违背谷歌的AI原则，并可能助长伤害。这是谷歌内部对军事AI合作的最大规模抗议，反映了科技界对AI军事化应用的持续担忧。

title: David Silver of DeepMind raises $1B to build AI that learns without human data
summary: DeepMind联合创始人David Silver筹集11亿美元，创立新公司以开发无需人类数据的AI系统。该研究聚焦于强化学习和自监督学习，旨在让AI通过与环境交互自主发现知识。Silver是AlphaGo和AlphaZero的核心发明者，其新项目可能推动AI向通用智能迈出关键一步，引发业界高度关注。

title: microsoft/VibeVoice
summary: 微软开源VibeVoice，一个前沿语音AI模型，专注于高保真语音合成与理解。该模型在自然度、多语言支持和实时交互方面达到新高度，支持情感表达和口音模仿。开源策略有望加速语音AI在客服、教育、无障碍等领域的应用，降低开发者门槛。

title: An open-source spec for Codex orchestration: Symphony
summary: OpenAI发布Codex编排规范Symphony，旨在标准化多智能体协作流程。Symphony定义了智能体间通信、任务分配和状态管理的开放协议，支持跨平台集成。该规范有望解决当前AI Agent生态碎片化问题，推动复杂自动化任务的规模化部署，是AI工程化的重要里程碑。

title: OpenAI available at FedRAMP Moderate
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is available at FedRAMP Moderate authorization for ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API, enabling secure AI adoption for U.S. federal agencies.
summary: OpenAI获得FedRAMP Moderate授权，允许美国联邦机构使用ChatGPT Enterprise和API。FedRAMP是美国政府云服务安全标准，此次认证意味着OpenAI满足政府级数据保护要求，可正式进入公共部门市场。此举将加速AI在政务、国防等敏感领域的合规应用。

title: Canonical lays out a plan for AI in Ubuntu Linux
raw_excerpt: One of the most popular Linux distributions is about to get an influx of AI features. As reported by Phoronix , Jon Seager, VP of engineering at Ubuntu developer Canonical, shared a blog post on Monday detailing plans to add AI features to the Linux distro over the next year. As the post states, the AI features "will come in two forms: first as a means of enhancing existing OS functionality with AI models in the background, and latterly in the form of 'AI native' features and workflows for those who want them." These features will range from accessibility tools like improved speech-to-text and text-to-speech to agentic AI features for tasks … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Canonical公布Ubuntu Linux AI功能路线图，计划在未来一年内集成AI能力。第一阶段将AI用于增强现有系统功能（如语音转文字），第二阶段推出原生AI工作流。Ubuntu作为最流行的Linux发行版，此举将推动AI在开发者桌面和服务器端的普及，可能改变Linux生态的AI应用格局。
